title.narrative: UNESCO/China - The Great Wall Co-sponsored Fellowships Programme

description.narrative: The UNESCO/China – the Great Wall Co-Sponsored Fellowships Programme supports human resource development in developing countries by offering study and research opportunities at selected universities in China. Jointly implemented by UNESCO and the Government of China, it provides up to 75 fellowships annually for qualified candidates, with particular attention to Africa, Small Island Developing States, least developed countries, women and young people. Key activities include annual calls for applications, national nominations, candidate screening and selection, fellowship awards, study or research placements, regular reporting, impact tracking and communication activities. Its expected results are trained professionals and scholars, stronger knowledge sharing, and enhanced international cooperation.
